description: This source file implements utility functions for feature support detection in ANGLE, including parsing rules from JSON, system info management, and decision logic for whether to use ANGLE based on scenarios, applications, and device info.

classes.name: StringPart
classes.description: Encapsulates a string with wildcard matching capability.

classes.name: IntegerPart
classes.description: Encapsulates a 32-bit unsigned integer with wildcard matching.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a version with major, minor, subminor, and patch components, supporting matching and string representation.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Represents an application with optional version info, supporting matching.

classes.name: GPU
classes.description: Represents a GPU with vendor, device ID, and version, supporting matching.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device with manufacturer, model, and associated GPUs, supporting matching.

classes.name: Scenario
classes.description: Represents a specific scenario with application and device info for rule matching.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Defines a rule with application and device criteria and an ANGLE usage decision.

classes.name: RuleList
classes.description: Holds a list of rules, supports parsing from JSON, and determines ANGLE usage for scenarios.

methods.name: CreateVersionFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Version object from JSON data.

methods.name: CreateApplicationFromJson
methods.description: Creates an Application object from JSON data.

methods.name: CreateGpuFromJson
methods.description: Creates a GPU object from JSON data.

methods.name: CreateDeviceFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Device object from JSON data.

methods.name: ReadRulesFromJsonString
methods.description: Parses JSON string to create a list of rules.

methods.name: getUseANGLE
methods.description: Determines whether ANGLE should be used for a given scenario based on rules.
